footer.sell: Bring your shop to Nafaa Market

about.title: About Nafaa Market
body: Nafaa Market brings the shops in your city online: restaurants, kiryana stores, pharmacies, boutiques, salons, clinics and more.
Every shop on Nafaa Market runs on Nafaa POS, so prices and stock come straight from the shop's counter. What you see is what the shop has.
Each shop prepares and delivers its own orders. Nafaa Market connects you with them and keeps you updated until your order arrives.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: By using Nafaa Market you agree to these terms. Orders are placed with the shop you choose; the shop is responsible for the items, their quality and delivery.
Prices and availability can change until you place your order. If anything changes at checkout, we show you the new total before you confirm.
Please give a correct address and phone number. Shops may cancel orders they cannot deliver.
Nafaa may suspend accounts that misuse the service.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: We collect your name, mobile number, addresses and order history to deliver your orders and show you your account.
Your phone number and address are shared only with the shop (and its rider or courier) handling your order.
We never sell your personal data. You can delete your account at any time from Account settings.

refund.title: Refund and return policy
body: If an item is missing, damaged or wrong, contact the shop from your order page within 24 hours.
Cash on delivery orders that are cancelled before dispatch are not charged.
Returns of clothes, shoes and electronics follow each shop's own return policy shown on its page.
